Name: Mixed Seeds Tub O' Flowers
Author: BucketListMod
Description:
A simple mod that changes the recipe of Tub O' Flowers to use Mixed Flower Seeds instead of four individual flower seeds.

Recommended compliment: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2758]Seasonal Tub O' Flowers by MouseyPounds[/url]﻿, leaning into the idea of the Mixed Flower Seeds being used to craft it.

Manifest.Name: Mixed Seeds Tub O' Flowers
Manifest.Description: Changes the Tub O' Flowers recipie to use Mixed Flower Seeds.
